overallExplanation: Zambia Agricultural Bank plays a vital role in financing the agricultural sector but faces significant operational and financial challenges that require urgent attention. A focused turnaround plan addressing capital adequacy, NPL management, technology modernization, and regulatory compliance is essential to ensure long-term sustainability.
